generated_at_note: inherited from the deterministic benchmark manifest; the runner reads no wall clock

metric_definitions.detected: the deterministic engine reported >=1 finding, produced a verified candidate, or the PoC oracle passed; container-only 'universal.detected' is not used as a vulnerability detection
metric_definitions.vuln_eliminated: PoC oracle status pass AND unified gate success
metric_definitions.regression: PoC verifier pass covers the declared PoC+regression cases; for a failed verification, regression is false only if a candidate regression case crashed/timed out
metric_definitions.independently_verified: independent verifier decision=verified; null/not_run when no independent verifier is available (generator self-verification is never accepted)
metric_definitions.false_verified: deterministic verified claim rejected by an available independent verifier; must be 0
metric_definitions.not_run: repair or verification could not be executed; reason recorded
metric_definitions.patch_plan_sha256: sha256 of the exchanged patch plan (canonical JSON) when a candidate/plan was produced
metric_definitions.verifier_id: independent verifier identity from its report
metric_definitions.layout_status: pipeline plan-aware patch.rewrite status (passed/failed/not_run); stack guard insertions and associated rodata changes are declared in the exchanged plan
metric_definitions.real_verification: true only when the independent verifier decision is verified with an executed oracle (never inferred)

results.vulnerability_class: synthetic unsupported-container negative control (no vulnerability; fail-closed expectation)
results.verifier_reason: no verified candidate exists to independently verify
results.error: big-endian elf/x86_64 is outside the repair matrix

limitations: deterministic repair readiness only: no AI provider and no network is used by this runner.
false_verified must be 0; a deterministic verified claim rejected by an available independent verifier fails the run.
when no independent verifier is available, independently_verified is null/not_run and deterministic claims are never relabelled as independently verified.
host-unavailable or raised repair calls are recorded as not_run with an explicit reason; availability is never fabricated.

candidate bytes, patch plans, exchanged metadata and independent verifier reports are persisted per sample under samples/<sample_id>/ and covered by SHA256SUMS (evidence only; not executed by the runner).
